name: classify_instruments_no_ddl_20261107
comment: classify-instruments ran FOUR ALTER TABLE symbol_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS statements on every live
run, each taking an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the whole table against db_adapter's 3s lock_timeout — the same
defect that killed etf-analyst-enrich on 2026-11-07 07:00 ET ('canceling statement due to lock timeout').
The DDL is migrations/2026_11_07_symbol_profiles_instrument_cols.sql now; the run only reads
information_schema and exits 2 naming the migration when a column is absent. Pins: no DDL in the run path,
no write statement at all from the real run, the migration defines all four columns, the missing-column exit
is 2 with a failed receipt, and the dry run promises no write. Hermetic fakes; no DB, no network.
